anonymousBody: Your everyday activity on the platform stays anonymous; other users cannot see who you really are
certificationBody: For certificates, credits and showcasing results after a challenge closes
eligibilityBody: To check from your academic details whether you meet a challenge's eligibility requirements
encryptionBody: Your personal details are protected with industry-standard encryption against unauthorized access
isolationBody: Your real-name details are kept strictly apart from your platform account so the two cannot be linked
purposeBody: Your real-name details are used only when you apply for or start a challenge that requires them, and for nothing else
rightsBody: Several layers of protection keep your privacy safe on the platform while meeting the few challenges that need real-name details. Every access to your details is logged, and you can review those logs at any time.
verificationBody: To confirm who participants are, so participation is genuine and valid
